from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
w,h = im.size
# define crops: (name, box in fractional coords)
crops = {
 'upper_ant':   (0.36, 0.10, 0.62, 0.50),
